It is certified that having been duly appointed Executor of the last will and testament of SETH
STAPLES of Turner, in the county of Cumber-
land, Yeoman, deceased has taken upon himself
that trust and given bond as the law directs; he
therefore requests all persons who are indebted TO
the Deceased's estate, to make immediate payment;
and those who have any demands thereon to exhibit
the same to JOSIAH STAPLES, Executor.
He will attend to the settling accounts
the first and third Tuesdays of the three following
months, at the house of the deceased.
